params.prompt: Cinematic miniature diorama, heroic armored-tech workshop aesthetic: glossy hot-rod red and gold metal plating with crisp panel lines and rivets, brushed gunmetal accents, warm tungsten garage lighting, subtle cool reactor-glow highlights, tilt-shift miniature photography look, isometric three-quarter aerial view, ultra detailed, empty, unoccupied, no people, architectural model quality. On a plain solid deep warm charcoal background with a soft contact shadow. Palette: hot-rod red #B91C1C, gold #D4A017, gunmetal #3F3F46, reactor glow #7DD3FC, warm white #FAF7F0. No text, no letters, no logos, centered composition. Subject: a circular team assembly hall — a round command table at the center, a ring of individual work stations arranged around it each glowing warmly as if just switched on, armored suit alcoves recessed along the curved wall, tall red and gold banners.
